QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Thunder Breaker
QuestInfo.0: The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Thunder Breaker, the Pirate of lightning, talk to the #bChief Knight of Lightning #p1101007##k.
QuestInfo.1: If you want to become a thrill-seeking Thunder Breaker of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101007#.
QuestInfo.2: You are now a Thunder Breaker!

0.0: So ye've past the test and are ready to choose yer path, eh? Well, if ye choose to be a Thunder Breaker, I'd be delighted to welcome ye to me metaphorical crew.
0.1: A Thunder Breaker is like a Brawler. #bWe use STR to pound our enemies with naught but our knuckles!#k
0.2: We've made a pact with #bFulgar, the spirit of lightning#k, who'll fight with us, guard us, and even jump into our knuckles now and then for a little extra oomph.
0.3: Even though we fight with our fists, we're not barbarians! I expect me crew to treat others with kindness and be real refined-like, savvy? If yer on board with that philosophy, I'd love for ye to join the path of #bThunder Breaker#k.

yes.0: I'll wait for ye to decide what ye want to do.
